page.title: Plan a service
page.description: Innovation Middleman: a draft Framework Implementation Plan for an innovation from the ROPS Library, made for your institution and municipality — with GUS data and current grant calls.
page.eyebrow: Innovation Middleman — implementation assistant · for OPS, CUS, PCPR and organisations
page.lead: Choose an innovation from the ROPS Library and answer four questions about your institution. We will prepare a draft Framework Implementation Plan — with GUS data about your municipality and the grant calls that could fund it.
page.sourceGus: GUS (Statistics Poland), Local Data Bank — population of municipalities

innovation.title: Which innovation do you want to implement?
innovation.description: Choose a solution from the ROPS Kraków Social Innovation Library.

institution.title: What kind of institution?
institution.description: Who will run the service? The roles and partners in the plan depend on it.

gmina.title: Where?
gmina.description: In which municipality will the service start? We will add GUS data about its residents to the plan.
gmina.label: Municipality
gmina.hint: Type the beginning of the name and choose the municipality from the list.

resources.title: Resources and needs
resources.description: A rough answer is fine — the plan will show what needs to be made more precise.
resources.staff: How many people can work on the service?
resources.groupSize: How many people do you want to help? (if you know)
resources.groupSizeHint: Number of people served in the first year. You can leave this empty.
resources.needs: Is there anything else we should know? (optional)
resources.needsHint: For example: who it is mainly for, what experience you have, what worries you. Please don't enter personal data.

validation.innovation: Choose an innovation from the list — select one.
validation.gmina: Choose a municipality from the list.
validation.gminaPick: Choose a municipality from the suggestions.
validation.staff: Choose how many people can work on the service.
validation.groupSizeInteger: Give the number of people as a whole number.
validation.groupSizeDigits: Type the number of people in digits, for example 40 — or leave the field empty.
validation.groupSizeMin: The number of people must be greater than zero.
validation.needsLength: Please shorten the description to {max} characters.
validation.email: Enter an e-mail address, for example centre@municipality.pl, or leave the field empty.

picker.searchHint: Type a word from the title or topic, for example “older people”, “autism”, “family”.
picker.none: We found nothing. Try another word.
picker.total: In the Library: {count}. Those with a ROPS Framework Implementation Plan come first.

view.heading: Your Framework Implementation Plan
view.note: Figures about the municipality come from GUS, quotes from the innovation card, and grant calls from ROPS announcements. Your institution fills in the places marked “[TO BE COMPLETED]”; budget amounts are indicative and “to be verified”.
view.streamingAi: The AI assistant is preparing the plan…
view.done: The plan is ready. You can send it to ROPS, print it or download it.

source.ai: The description was written by the AI assistant; figures, budget and grant calls were inserted by the system from the source data.
source.mixed: The AI assistant wrote only part of the description — the other parts come from the template. Figures, budget and grant calls were inserted by the system from the source data.
source.template: Plan from the template — without AI. Every part was filled in from the innovation card, GUS data and ROPS announcements.

view.errorGeneric: The plan could not be prepared. Please try again.
view.errorConnection: The connection was interrupted. Please try again.

support.sent: We have sent the plan to ROPS
support.checkData: Please check the details and try again.
support.heading: Ask ROPS for help with implementation
support.lead: We will send this draft plan to ROPS specialists in Kraków. You will get a case code — use it to check the reply, without creating an account.
support.emailHint: We store it encrypted and use it only for this case.

s1.intro: The aim is to start a service in the municipality of {gmina}, based on the innovation “{title}” from the ROPS Kraków Social Innovation Library. The service is run by: {institution}.
s1.problems: The problem the innovation responds to (from the card):
s1.goal: Aim in numbers: {todo} — whom the service should help, and by when.
s1.goalPlanned: Aim in numbers: {todo} — whom the service should help, and by when (the institution plans to reach {people}).

s2.target: Target group according to the innovation card:
s2.residents: Residents of the municipality of {name} ({kind}, {powiat}), as of 31 December {year}:
s2.pop80Value: {n} ({share}% of residents; median for Małopolska municipalities: {median}%)
s2.change: Change in the number of residents {from}–{to}
s2.changeNone: no comparison — the municipality changed its boundaries after {from}
s2.source: Source: {name}, {year} — [BDL query for this municipality]({url}), retrieved {date}.
s2.scale: Scale of the service: the institution plans to reach {people}.
s2.scaleSeniors: Scale of the service: the institution plans to reach {people}. That is {share}% of the municipality's residents aged 65+.
s2.scaleTodo: Scale of the service: {todo} — how many people the service will reach in the first year.
s2.targetTodo: Number of people in the target group in the municipality: {todo} — the GUS table above covers all residents; data on this group is usually held by the social welfare centre or a local needs assessment.

s3.solution: What the solution is (from the card):
s3.works: Does it work — results described in the card:
s3.adapt: How to adapt the service to your institution in {gmina}: {todo} — place, days and hours, how to reach people, what to change compared with the card.
s3.licence: Licence (as the Polish card states it): „{licence}”.
s3.licenceNone: Licence: not given on the card — {todo} (agree it with the authors).

s4.intro: The timetable is a proposal to adjust. Start date: {todo}.
s4.prepTeamTodo: Contact with the authors of the innovation and the terms for using the materials{licence}; a coordinator; team training ({staff}).
s4.recruitShortTodo: Information about the service in {gmina}; applications and eligibility.
s4.recruitTodo: Information about the service in {gmina}; applications and eligibility of participants.
s4.deliverTodo: The service as in section 3; a team meeting every month and the indicators from section 9 collected.
s4.evalSummaryTodo: Surveys, comparison with the targets, decision whether to continue.
s4.prepTodo: Contact with the authors of the innovation and the terms for using the materials{licence}; appointing a coordinator; agreements with partners.
s4.teamTodo: Putting the team together ({staff}); training in the method described in the card.
s4.evaluationTodo: Surveys of participants and the team; results compared with the targets.
s4.summaryTodo: Pilot report; decision on continuing and on the source of funding.

s5.team: Team available to the institution: {staff} (as stated by the institution).
s5.coordinatorTasks: Timetable, contact with the authors of the innovation and partners, reporting
s5.leadersTasks: Working with participants using the method from the card
s5.authorsTasks: Training the team, advice during the pilot
s5.authorsSkills: To be agreed with the authors
s5.onePerson: With one person in the team, plan a stand-in and a partner from section 6 from the start.

s6.authorsNone: {todo} (the card does not name the authors)
s6.authorsRole: Sharing knowledge and materials, training the team, advice — to be agreed
s6.rops: Regional Social Policy Centre in Kraków (ROPS) — Małopolska Social Innovation Hub
s6.ropsRole: Support with implementation, information about calls
s6.ops: Social welfare centre or social services centre in {gmina}
s6.opsRole: Reaching participants, referring people to the service
s6.pcpr: County family support centre ({powiat}) or the body that does its work
s6.pcprRole: Support for families and people with disabilities in the county

area.seniors: Seniors' clubs, a University of the Third Age, the municipal seniors' council — if they exist in the municipality
area.family: Schools and nursery schools in the municipality, the psychological and educational counselling centre
area.disability: Organisations of people with disabilities, occupational therapy workshops — if there are any nearby
area.health: Primary health care in the municipality
area.mental_health: Primary health care, a mental health centre covering the municipality — if there is one
area.homelessness: Services for people experiencing homelessness, street workers
area.poverty: The county labour office, social economy organisations

s6.areaRole: Information about the service, recruiting participants together
s6.localTodo: Names of local partners and the scope of cooperation: {todo}.

cat.staff: Pay for the team delivering the service
cat.training: Team training, supervision, advice from the authors of the innovation
cat.materials: Materials, equipment and fittings the service needs
cat.travel: Travel for participants or the team
cat.info: Information about the service and recruiting participants

s7.note: The split into categories is a working assumption of the plan generator, not a ROPS standard or a quote. No amount is a market price — every item has to be costed from local rates and the call rules.
s7.rural: For a rural or urban-rural municipality a higher share for travel was assumed (5–15%).
s7.uwLimit: The grant in the „Usługa Wrażliwa” call was up to {money} — a budget above this amount needs another source of funding.

s8.lowUptakePrevent: Recruit through institutions that already know the people; information in plain language; a personal invitation
s8.notFit: The method on the card does not fit local conditions
s8.notFitPrevent: A short test with a small group at the start, and adjustments together with the authors of the innovation
s8.staffLeavesPrevent: At least two people trained in the method; written procedures
s8.noMoney: No money to continue after the pilot
s8.noMoneyPrevent: Talk about funding from the middle of the project; results from section 9 as an argument for the municipality
s8.dataPrevent: Collect as little data as possible, consent, documents stored securely
s8.dispersed: Participants spread across a municipality that is losing residents ({change} in 10 years)
s8.dispersedPrevent: The service at people's homes or organised transport; combining visits in one area
s8.travel: The place of the service is hard to reach
s8.travelPrevent: Transport for participants or a mobile service; times that fit public transport
s8.onePersonPrevent: A partner from section 6 and a stand-in planned from the start

s9.served: Number of people reached by the service
s9.rated: Share of participants who found the service helpful
s9.ratedMeasure: A short survey at the end
s9.trained: Number of team members trained in the method
s9.specific: A result specific to this innovation (see “Does it work?” on the card)
s9.decision: Decision to continue the service after the pilot
s9.decisionMeasure: Decision of the institution or the municipality

s10.none: No calls in the database. Source of funding: {todo}.
